description: Developer platform providing hosting for software development and version control using Git, plus collaboration features.
auth_notes: Supports Personal Access Tokens (classic or fine-grained) passed via Bearer tokens, GitHub App tokens (JWT and installation access tokens), and OAuth2 tokens.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free GitHub account self-serve and generate personal access tokens or register free GitHub Apps at no cost.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs covering repositories, issues, pull requests, actions, users, and organization management.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server maintained directly by GitHub under their organization, though community implementations exist.
rationale: GitHub provides a robust, publicly documented REST/GraphQL API with self-serve free developer credential access.

evidence.note: GitHub REST API documentation covering endpoints and usage
Authentication methods including personal access tokens, apps, and bearer tokens
Guide on creating GitHub Apps and acquiring credentials self-serve
List of official and reference MCP servers showing no official GitHub vendor server
